QuestInfo.name: Hat Required
QuestInfo.0: Rondo's hat flew off to reveal...animal ears? Talk to Rondo, who's hiding in the bushes.
QuestInfo.1: Rondo's embarrassed without his hat and wants you to find it for him. The hat must've fallen below... \r\nGet the hat from #bLuke#k and return it to Rondo.
QuestInfo.2: You've returned Rondo's hat to him.

0.0: Thanks a lot, buddy. I can't go anywhere without my hat. You happy now? \r\n#L0##bAre your ears real? Can I touch them?#l\n#k
0.1: Are you listening? This is your fault, dimwit. How am I supposed to talk to humans now, huh? Huh?! \r\n#L0##bI honestly don't think anyone's going to care...#l\n#k
0.2: Shows how much you know. They're all going to give me strange looks.\r\n#L0##bTo be honest, you looked kind of strange even WITH your hat...#l\n#k
0.3: Somebody thinks they're soooo funny, don't they? It's your fault I lost my #bhat#k, so get it back.

yes.0: #rThe hat fell down below...somewhere.#k Go get it.

no.0: You want me to hide here the rest of my life? You're a monster.

item.0: If you can't find my hat, maybe somebody took it. Ask around. Ask #bLuke#k. Do I have to spell it out for you?
